question: Should legacy v0.1.x consumers receive a version-gated token contract, or should matching Carapace CSS be released before this refresh is accepted?
rationale: The generated downstream content is intentionally sourced from upstream, so choosing the permanent compatibility and release contract cannot be safely repaired in this PR without maintainer direction.

options.title: Version-gate upstream guidance
options.body: Keep the legacy alias limited to tokens shipped by its supported CSS package, then regenerate the refresh.

options.title: Release matching CSS first
options.body: Publish the CSS containing the newly documented tokens and explicitly migrate the supported consumer package version before regenerating.

options.title: Pause this migration refresh
options.body: Leave the generated update unmerged until the compatibility contract is settled upstream.

recommendation.title: Version-gate upstream guidance
recommendation.body: Keep the legacy alias limited to tokens shipped by its supported CSS package, then regenerate the refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review already identifies the affected upstream contract and the acceptable resolution paths.
